name: Stoutlager Inn
summary: In Thelsamar, Stoutlager Inn welcomes travelers crossing western Loch Modan with a warm hearth and a place to gather.

sections.title: A Welcoming Hearth in the Hills
sections.body: Stoutlager Inn draws miners, mountaineers, and travelers passing between Dun Morogh and the Wetlands. They trade rumors, find beds, and share dwarven ale beneath its roof. Beyond Thelsamar, troggs and kobolds make the wilderness dangerous, so the inn’s stone walls and fires offer welcome shelter.

faq.q: What services are available at the Stoutlager Inn?
faq.answer: Travelers crossing Loch Modan can find beds, provisions, and drinks at Stoutlager Inn. The innkeeper can bind hearthstones, and local merchants sell supplies.

faq.q: Where is the Stoutlager Inn located?
faq.answer: Stoutlager Inn stands beside the main road in the center of Thelsamar, the main Alliance town in western Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why is the inn so important to Thelsamar?
faq.answer: Stoutlager Inn gives Thelsamar a place for food, lodging, and news. Local mountaineers post bounties there, and travelers plan excursions into the surrounding hills.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you may find the warmth of home at Stoutlager Inn. Its hospitality, fresh ale, and reliable company are welcome far from Ironforge.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can find shelter and prepare at Stoutlager Inn before heading north toward the Wetlands or patrolling the troubled valleys around the loch.
